title: EmDash Apply: the clean-up of hidden languages after hand-over runs on its own clock, not the run's signal
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines, and whether the test 'the clean-up outlives the run: the run’s signal is aborted as it ends, before its end waits for the clean-up' is 'ok'.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 30); the named test is 'ok': with the run's signal aborted right after apply returns (as brief-build does before dispose), every entry of the hidden language is unpublished and the clean-up line says '0 failed, 0 not reached'.
evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand, final check on the image of 2f59bf3e8: every EmDash Apply logged '[brief] <site>: hidden languages after hand-over: 0 unpublished, 39 failed, 0 not reached' — the clean-up was made on ctx.signal, which brief-build aborts as the run ends, before dispose waits for it.
fence: Only the signal the clean-up's requests carry changes; what it reads and unpublishes, its concurrency and its HIDE_MS bound do not.
